summary: No execution this turn, and that is the substance of the submission: with only the tail of the run's window left after the preflight, I could not build and verify another harness honestly, so rather than request an unverified basis I recorded where the investigation stands and what the next probe must be. The Q2 account is unchanged and complete on every axis measured: five configurations of the same removal (singleton remainder under CheckQuorum, under PreVote, the forwarded route with a learner requester, a two-voter remainder under PreVote, and a two-voter remainder under CheckQuorum) and none of them produces the outcome the question allows - the shortcut hands out a frozen index, the larger remainder accepts and then loses the request when the removed leader's term turns, and under CheckQuorum the removed leader keeps its lease, is never replaced, and answers from a round it counted its own acknowledgement into. The one measurement the account still flags is whether the remaining voters eventually elect a replacement once their own election timers run; that is a small extension of the verified CheckQuorum harness (tick the voters past their timeouts), it was drafted this turn as assurance_voter_replacement_test.go but its scenario is not yet written or run, so no receipt was requested. Validation reports valid with no effects, and I note it explicitly rather than dressing a no-op turn as progress.
